appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'
Y-axis has labeled ticks from 0 to 3,000 in increments of 200.
X-axis has labeled ticks for years: 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023.
A single blue line traces production values across the years.
Data point for 2018 is at 2,800 on the y-axis.
Data point for 2019 is at 2,400 on the y-axis.

public_definitions: Review the Factory F production dashboard for the 2018-2023 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the output trend.
Use the Factory F production dashboard as the evidence source for the output trend routing decision.
The available options are: 'Route to output stability response', 'Route to output growth response', 'Route to output decline response'.
